Yes, multi-object display verbs is still on the list for Quest 5.2 - http://quest.codeplex.com/workitem/848 - so it will be in both desktop and web editors soon!

comments.author: TThomas
comments.content: Any plans for multiplayer.. Even if it wasn't realtime could be cool.. Things like message boards or auction houses with items discovered or crafted while playing.. It makes me really sad that muds haven't evolved the same way IF has.. To this day the parsers are still very primitive and most are little more than class based combat games with chat..
